class A extends BWebServlet {
  void a(WebOp op) {
    CsrfUtil.verifyCsrfToken(op.getRequest());
    BUser caller = op.getUser();
    if (!caller.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(prop, v, op);
  }
  void b(WebOp op) {
    BComponent self = this;
    if (!self.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(prop, v, op);
  }
  void c(WebOp op) {
    if (!super.getPermissions(op).hasOperatorWrite()) return;
    target.set(prop, v, op);
  }

    Object who = (BUser) op.getUser();

    target.set(prop, v, op);
